idle.secondary_motion: balanced bottle with restrained alternating wobble

attack.secondary_motion: inertial bottle wobble with anticipation, overshoot and damping

transition.idle_to_attack: Queue attack and start it when idle reaches bridge frame 0, 3, 5 or 7; attack frame 0 is pixel-identical to animation_base.
transition.attack_to_idle: When attack frame 7 finishes, resume idle at frame 0; both frames are pixel-identical to animation_base.
